rules.text: Board buffs (12 h, Alt+B) cover P.Atk/P.Def/M.Atk/M.Def, Haste, crit, speed/Wind Walk, Focus, Guidance, Berserker, Empower, Acumen, Concentration, Mental Shield, Magic Barrier, Improved buffs, Blessing of Queen, songs and dances; pet schemes too. The board does not give Prophecy of Fire/Wind/Water, Chant of Victory, Magnus' Chant or Voice of Prophecy, and gives most resists only with premium.
A class buff with the same abnormal type as a board buff is a board conflict: cast it only when the board buff is missing.
Owner rule: healers ONLY heal. On these lines that means Bishop/Cardinal (and the Cleric/Prophet/Hierophant healer tiers): every attack / CC / Inquisitor row of a healer class is auto:false.
Item costs: 3031 = Spirit Ore, 8874 = Einhasad's Holy Water, 8876 = Magic Symbol. A skill fails without its item.
AoE rule: AoE only when 3+ mobs stand inside the skill's radius.
The class_skills md "kind" column is wrong for several skills (target-type labels): never auto-cast a skill just because it is labelled "self buff".
Inquisitor 1520 is not a self buff: it transforms the Bishop into a holy attacker (6 h) and blocks heals. Never auto.
Return 1050 teleports you to town. Never auto.
Invocation 1430 stuns yourself for 30 s (P.Def x0.1, MP per tick, 15 min reuse). Manual only, out of combat.
Body To Mind 1157 spends HP to gain MP: an MP tool, not a buff.
Requiem 1049 and Repose 1034 are AoE effects on undead enemies around you. Never (healer).
Word of Fear 1272 is an AoE fear on enemies around you (150 s reuse). Emergency only.
Mass Warrior Bane 1344 and Mass Mage Bane 1345 strip enemy buffs in an AoE (PvP). Never in PvE.
Mass Block Shield 1360 and Mass Block Wind Walk 1361 are AoE enemy debuffs (strip and block buffs, PvP). Never in PvE.
Seed of Fire 1285 is a real self buff (+20 fire attack, 10 min): keep it up (Sorcerer 66+).
Group Heal 1027, Greater Group Heal 1219 and Major Group Heal 1402 are party heals (range 1000), not self heals: party heal logic.
Mass Resurrection 1254 resurrects dead clan members only (DEAD_PLEDGE), not the party: only if the dead are clanmates.
Purification Field 1425 and Miracle 1426 are clan-wide (PLEDGE) cleanse / full heal, cost a Magic Symbol, 20 / 60 min reuse. Manual only.
Balance Life 1335 and Benediction 1271 are party heals (Balance Life evens out HP %, Benediction full-heals the party but only works at own MP <= 25 %): heal logic.
Restore Life 1258 heals a friendly target for 15-30 % of its max HP (cannot target monsters): heal logic.
Cancellation 1056 strips enemy buffs (25 % chance, up to 5). Never in PvE.
Curse Gloom 1263 is a debuff (M.Def down, unholy weakness) with small damage: an opener debuff.
Day of Doom 1422 and Anti-Summoning Field 1424 place a ground NPC field (PvP debuff / anti-summon), cost a Magic Symbol, 30 min reuse. Never auto.
Mass Surrender to Fire 1383 is centred on your servitor (SUMMON POINT_BLANK): only when the pet stands in a pack.
Chain Heal 1553 is a party heal (target plus up to 9 most-hurt nearby allies, 30 % of max HP each, diminishing): heal logic (Cardinal 83+).
Arcane Shield 1556 is an emergency skill (70 % of damage taken goes to MP for 10 s, 5 min reuse): emergency only, never as a routine buff.

H5 additions (highFiveNewClassSkillTree.xml) are in the regenerated md and count as ground truth: Dimension Spiral 1558 (Warlock / Arcana Lord 40-85), Aura Blast 1554 (81), Aura Cannon 1555 (82), Arcane Shield 1556 (83, Archmage), Servitor Share 1557 (83, Soultaker / Arcana Lord), Chain Heal 1553 (83, Cardinal), Resist Earth 1548 (Prophet 60-68), Piercing Attack 1564 (Hierophant 80, passive, no action).

Forgotten Scroll skills (Enlightenment, Sublime Self-Sacrifice, Servitor Barrier, Vampiric Mist, Meteor, Improved Combat/Condition, Counter Critical ...) are in no class tree; L2Toggle does not auto-learn them. Use them only if a character owns them.
Death Spike 1148 is a normal enemy nuke and needs no corpse and no Cursed Bone in H5. Corpse Burst 1155 is the skill that needs a corpse.
Restore Life 1258 is an instant heal for 15/20/25/30 % of max HP (8 s cast, 30 s reuse), not a HoT.
Gehenna 1423 and Day of Doom 1422 (30 min reuse, Magic Symbol) and the PvP Banes 1344 / 1345 never belong in an auto rotation.
Bishop 1-19 "attacks until 20: Wind Strike 1177, Vampiric Touch 1147" goes against the healer-only rule (see the healer conflict note on class 10).
Chain Heal 1553 for Bishop 76-85 is correct (83+), but the md labels it "debuff/CC": treat it as a party heal.
Never auto: Volcano 1419, Gehenna 1423, Day of Doom 1422, Anti-Summoning Field 1424, Miracle 1426, Purification Field 1425 (Magic Symbol, 20-60 min reuse).
Never auto: Return 1050, Inquisitor 1520, Invocation 1430 (in combat).

Never auto (PvP): Mass Warrior Bane 1344, Mass Mage Bane 1345, Warrior Bane 1350, Mage Bane 1351, Block Shield 1358, Block Wind Walk 1359, Mass Block Shield 1360, Mass Block Wind Walk 1361, Cancellation 1056, Betray 1380, Erase 1395.
Never Curse Death Link 1159 at full own HP.
Never Benediction 1271 unless own MP <= 25 %.
Celestial Shield 1418 only as a last resort.
Never Corpse Life Drain 1151 when a spoiler needs the corpse.
Never Sleeping Cloud 1072 / Mass Fear 1381 / Word of Fear 1272 on a pack the party is fighting.

rows.name: Prophecy of Fire
rows.trigger: Main reason to bring it (78). The board excludes it. Single-target buff: P.Atk x1.1, M.Atk x1.2, P.Def/M.Def x1.2, attack and cast speed x1.2, crit damage x1.2, HP regen x1.2, -20 % run speed. 5 min, 10 Spirit Ore per cast. Cast on the main DDs and tank before each fight / raid. Ore cost limits how often [rec]. Same type as other Prophecies (one at a time).

when.text: on the main DDs and the tank before each fight / raid

rows.name: Elemental Protection
rows.trigger: Keep up on the party (20 min), 76. +20 to fire/water/wind/earth resist. Likely not on the board (premium resists) [U].

rows.name: Mystic Immunity
rows.trigger: Boss about to debuff the tank / DD (79). Debuff immunity for 30 s on a party member, 150 s reuse. Asterios: blocks most debuffs, not cancel or damage.

when.text: the boss is about to debuff the tank / DD

rows.name: Spell Turning
rows.trigger: Boss casting a big spell, within 150 (79). 50 % chance to cancel the cast, 30 s reuse. Range 150, so rarely usable [rec: manual].

when.text: the boss is casting a big spell

rows.why: guide [rec: manual]; owner rule: healers only heal
